name: protected-mode
note: -host: no mode: Keel listens on 127.0.0.1 unless -host says otherwise

name: masterauth
note: -primary-password-env: the primary's password, named by an environment variable
used_by: spotahome redis-operator (written with the password); redis_exporter (redacted)

name: requirepass
used_by: spotahome redis-operator (written with the password); redis_exporter (redacted)

name: loglevel
used_by: the official Docker image docs (--loglevel warning)

name: maxmemory-policy
used_by: Sidekiq (warns unless noeviction, read from INFO maxmemory_policy: lib/sidekiq/cli.rb); BullMQ (same warning, from INFO: src/classes/redis-connection.ts); Bitnami redis chart (an extraFlags example)

name: databases
used_by: redis_exporter (per-database metrics); redis-cli (CONFIG GET databases, src/redis-cli.c:9734)

name: lfu-decay-time
note: -lfu-decay-period: Redis decays an LFU counter by idle minutes; Keel by accesses

name: active-expire-effort
note: -active-expire-samples: Redis scales an effort of 1 to 10; Keel sets keys sampled per cycle

name: shutdown-timeout
note: -shutdown-timeout: Redis waits for replicas to catch up; Keel for cleanup and the log sync

name: repl-backlog-size
used_by: redis_exporter (config_repl_backlog_size); Bitnami redis chart (an extraFlags example)

name: maxmemory
used_by: redis_exporter (config_maxmemory, from CONFIG GET *: exporter/exporter.go extractConfigMetrics)

name: save
used_by: Bitnami redis chart (commonConfiguration: save ""); spotahome redis-operator (save 900 1, save 300 10); the official Docker image docs (redis-server --save 60 1)
